description: pump.fun's first-party constants graduate at ~85 SOL, derived from the invariant: not the ~22 SOL the opening-price sum gives.
30*1000/(1000-800) - 30 = 120: draining 80% of the token reserve takes the SOL reserve from 30 to 150; the threshold is the 120 SOL added (4x the initial reserve).
A deeper starting SOL reserve raises the graduation cost proportionally along the same curve shape.
If no real tokens are sellable off the curve, zero SOL is needed to graduate: a sanity anchor the opening-price model also passes.
